corrections.why: The NHLR description and fire-lookouts.org both give 8,142 feet (about 2,482 m). The 2,443 m figure matches only the NHLR data field, which says 8,014 ft.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: NHLR's data field says built 1935 but its description says built in 1936; fire-lookouts.org says built in 1935 and established in 1936. The story gives 1935 or 1936.

NHLR says the lookout remains in active service and is staffed five days a week in fire season; fire-lookouts.org, last updated March 2013 in the text read, says it was unstaffed in 2011. The story gives both.

The Forest Service trail page still describes the trail as ending at the lookout tower and does not say whether it stands. The 2021 Forest Service incident update and news photos say it was destroyed, so the record uses destroyed.
Forest Service gives a 0.6-mile trail from Forest Road 22S03a; fire-lookouts.org gives 1.25 miles from the parking area. The two may start from different points; the story gives both.

notes_for_editor: Brief coordinates (36.0161, -118.6143) match NHLR; fire-lookouts.org gives 36.0057 N, 118.3655 W, about 22 km away in longitude, so the brief coordinates were left unchanged. The brief elevation is corrected in corrections because two sources say 8,142 ft. The InciWeb citation uses the inciweb-dev.fs2c.usda.gov host the search returned; the canonical InciWeb address was not checked. NHLR is undated in the text read. The Forest Service trail page is undated in the text read. The 1947 and 1948 condor items come from a Forest Lookouts page that quotes Fresno Bee items. No source read describes the site after the 2021 fire beyond the rubble photos; access and any remains today are unverified. Two WebSearch calls and six distinct page reads were used.
